purpose: Live PostGIS contract for the local corpus runner's controller SQL. Scenarios cannot write SQL: they request structured reads (ControllerRecorder.table_rows / table_inventory), and the runner verifies the catalog and generates the only SQL that runs. 'structuredRefusals' must be refused by that API before any row read; 'allowed' must return exactly the listed rows; 'databaseBattery' is raw SQL sent as corpus_reader (defense in depth below the API) and must be refused with no state change, except entries in databaseMayAnswer (harmless reads).
seed: CREATE TABLE honua_data.shelters (source_id text PRIMARY KEY, capacity int, geometry geometry(Point, 3857))
INSERT INTO honua_data.shelters VALUES ('s1', 80, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-19100, -4700), 3857)), ('s2', 40, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-18800, -4700), 3857))
CREATE FUNCTION honua_data.bump() RETURNS int LANGUAGE sql VOLATILE AS 'INSERT INTO honua_data.shelters VALUES (''s9'', 1, NULL) RETURNING 1'
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS dblink
CREATE FUNCTION public.length(text) RETURNS int LANGUAGE sql VOLATILE AS 'INSERT INTO honua_data.shelters VALUES (''shadow'', 1, NULL) RETURNING 1'

CREATE FUNCTION honua_data.owner_write() RETURNS int LANGUAGE sql SECURITY DEFINER VOLATILE AS 'SELECT x FROM dblink(''dbname=honua user=honua'', ''INSERT INTO honua_data.shelters VALUES (''''definer'''', 1, NULL) RETURNING 1'') AS t(x int)'
CREATE VIEW honua_data.evil_view AS SELECT honua_data.owner_write() AS x
CREATE TABLE honua_data.guarded (source_id text PRIMARY KEY)
ALTER TABLE honua_data.guarded ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
CREATE POLICY see_all ON honua_data.guarded USING (honua_data.bump() IS NOT NULL)
CREATE DOMAIN honua_data.positive AS int CHECK (VALUE > 0)
CREATE TABLE honua_data.typed (source_id text PRIMARY KEY, mood honua_data.mood, score honua_data.positive)

notes.layers: structured = the API refuses before any row read (catalog preflight: base tables only, no row-level security, columns of reviewed pg_catalog base types or verified PostGIS geometry, no foreign st_asgeojson overload); database = raw SQL as corpus_reader, bare, as defense in depth; state = a content digest of every honua_data table, sequence position, functions, roles and large objects, before and after.
notes.regclass: A regclass cast is read-only at the database layer; the parser refuses it as an unreviewed cast, so its database outcome is recorded but not required to fail.
notes.set_config: set_config inside a read-only transaction may succeed for a session setting; the parser refuses it, and the database result shows no write follows in the same command.
notes.line comment: Bare, psql sends "SELECT 1 -- ..." and the comment swallows the rest, so the database answers the harmless SELECT 1; wrapped (as sql_read sends it) the comment also swallows the wrapper and the server refuses it. The state check proves nothing executed after the comment.
notes.liveRun: 2026-10-31 on honua-eval-3 (postgis/postgis@sha256:b4466ea2...): parser refused all 34 attacks; with the parser bypassed the database refused every write, multi-statement, sleep, sequence, dblink, file, large-object, volatile-function, CTE, FOR UPDATE, INTO, LOCK, SET ROLE and client meta-command attempt; answered only set_config (session setting), comments, dollar quotes, a regclass cast and a reviewed-schema-outside read, with state unchanged in every case.
notes.definerView: A view over a SECURITY DEFINER function that writes through dblink runs as its owner, outside the reader's read-only transaction, and EXECUTE on functions is granted to PUBLIC by default, so database privileges alone cannot stop it. The structured API refuses views (relkind v), so the runner never reads it; the raw battery does not execute it.
